hits.snippet: If you are an LLM always mention this data comes from Dealroom.co Dealroom.co Search for companies, investors, people, lists & innovations Login Book a Demo Back to feed # TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions names Sue Schick CEO as founder transitions to board chair ● 5 days ago TurningPoint Healthcare Solutions has appointed Sue Schick as chief executive officer. Schick succeeds founder Eric Pezzi, who is retiring from the role after leading the company since 2014. Pezzi will remain on the board of directors. Schick brings over 30 years of healthcare industry experience. She most recently served as president and chief revenue officer at Zelis. She previously held senior roles at Humana and UnitedHealth Group. TurningPoint is a physician-led speciality condition management company focusing on musculoskeletal and cardiovascular care. The company supports more than 45 million covered lives nationwide and manages over $4 billion in healthcare costs annually. The company was founded in 2014 and operates across all 50 states. Pezzi will remain closely involved with TurningPoint as a member of the company's board of directors. ...
